metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the forty leaves under the cat, two turnings of the glass at St Helen's, the loaf with Mistress Ansell, and the note that Midsummer is Tuesday.

yesterday: The king is finished. The last line is still the ruled line. Gib stays on the Holinshed.
Master Thwaite turned the glass twice. Sir John sat in his pew. Halberds stood at that pew.
You ate with Mistress Ansell. The loaf is still a thumb short, and still a penny.
Midsummer is Tuesday. You said so at night.
